title: GOODS-ALMA: 1.1 mm galaxy survey. I. Source catalog and optically dark galaxies
question: Which galaxies does a blind, contiguous 69 arcmin2 ALMA 1.1 mm survey of GOODS-South detect, and what are their counterparts (including HST-dark galaxies), redshifts, masses, AGN fraction and number counts?

data.angular_resolution: native ~0.24 arcsec; tapered to 0.29 and 0.60 arcsec circular beams

what.value: HUDF 1.3 mm ALMA catalogue for cross-checking detections

evidence.quote: The ALMA image of the full HUDF reaches a $\sigma_{1.3mm}$ = 35 $\mu$Jy (cite: Dunlop2017)

what.value: Redshifts and stellar masses from ZFOURGE

evidence.quote: We use the stellar masses and redshifts from the ZFOURGE catalogue, except when spectroscopic redshifts are available.
We find an X-ray counterpart for 65% of them (13/20) in the 7 Msec X-ray survey of GOODS–*South* with *Chandra* (cite: Luo2017).

what.value: SIDES simulation number counts for comparison

evidence.quote: We compare our results with an empirical model that predicts the number counts at far-IR and millimetre wavelengths, developed by (cite: Bethermin2017).

recipe.goal: Calibrate, average and image the mosaics
recipe.method: CASA calibration with ALMA scripts, average to 120 s and 8 channels, CLEAN MFS dirty maps per slice with u,v tapers, combine with noise-weighted mean
k-sigma clipping std in 100x100 pixel box every 4 pixels, 3 iterations, 3 sigma clip
BLOBCAT flood fill on SNR map of 0.60 arcsec mosaic; scan sigma_p 4-6 and sigma_f 2.5-4; require purity (Np-Nn)/Np >= 0.8 from inverted map
Blobcat peak, Galfit PSF fitting, PyBDSM, uvmodelfit; stacking; point-source assumption with corrections for AGS17 and AGS18

recipe.goal: Correct HST astrometry and identify counterparts
recipe.method: Cross-match Guo2013 with Pan-STARRS/GAIA within 0.5 arcsec, subtract median offset iteratively 3 times, then match counterparts within 0.6 arcsec; Monte Carlo chance-association probability

recipe.goal: Completeness, flux boosting, effective area, number counts
recipe.method: Inject 300 artificial sources per run, 100 runs per flux 0.5-2.4 mJy, sizes FWHM 0.2-0.9 arcsec; deboost; correct purity, completeness and effective area; fit DPL and Schechter functions
assumptions: ALMA sizes 1.4 times smaller than HST H-band sizes

recipe.goal: Derive galaxy properties and AGN fraction
recipe.method: Redshift and mass distributions from ZFOURGE; UVJ selection of SFGs; X-ray AGN criteria; EAZY and FAST for AGS4
assumptions: Salpeter IMF, flat LCDM H0=70, Om=0.7

evidence.quote: we obtain a total of 20 detections down to a flux density limit of $S_{1.1mm}$ $\approx$ 880 $\mu$Jy
The median redshift of our sample is 2.92$\pm$0.20
The mean redshift of the sample is $z$ = 3.03$\pm$0.17
we have detected 20% HST–dark galaxies (4 out of 20 robust detections)

answer_key.quantity: AGN fraction in mass-z box for ALMA sources

evidence.quote: we find that 50% of the ALMA sources host an AGN (8/16) as compared to only 14% (23/160)
corrected by $-$94$\pm$42 mas in right ascension, $\alpha$, and 262$\pm$50 mas in declination

answer_key.quantity: Completeness at 1.2 mJy for point sources

evidence.quote: at 1.2 mJy, our sample is 94$\pm$1% complete for point sources

evidence.loc: 5.5 Contribution to the cosmic infrared background
evidence.quote: We have resolved only 13.5$_{-8.6}^{+9.0}$% of the EBL into individual galaxies at 0.8 mJy.
The median size of our sample of 20 galaxies is 0$''$18

Primary-beam cutoff and sub-mosaic combination details

Astrometric offset table for each galaxy
